description:
Cast Bard by paying its mana cost.
When Bard enters, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Bard with haste plus at least one additional token due to Bard's effect.
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}.
When Kirol enters, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, use the ability of Elven Chorus to tap one of the Bard tokens, adding {1}.
Activate Kirol by tapping two creatures, copying Cadric's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Cadric's trigger, creating at least eight tokens due to the multiple copies of Bard.
Holding priority, use the ability of Elven Chorus to tap one of the creature tokens, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 6.
